postal_system.scope: UPU August 2026 format and address examples plus public Correios and government pages; no complete assignment set, explicit area relation or production geometry.

stages.definition: Reviewed format, operator surface, rights, quality and UI authority contract with exact reference hashes.

A current complete-for-declared-coverage, rights-cleared Timor-Leste TL-prefixed five-digit postcode assignment and exact Polygon/MultiPolygon delivery-area release preserves delivery-mode and locality exceptions using explicit permitted relations. Exact retrieval time, edition, validity, CRS, schema, topology, feature identity and SHA-256 reproducibly produce approved immutable artifacts. The real TL loader and API normalize the canonical seven-character code and return valid area geometry. The application searches country plus postcode, distinguishes loading/not-found/multiple/API-failure/invalid/non-area states, fits the map, renders a translucent fill and clear boundary, permits clear and repeat search, and displays normalized postcode, geometry type, official/derived/virtual authority, source, basis date and confidence. Points, postal offices, routes, P.O. boxes, organizations, learned cells and administrative boundaries are never promoted to postal polygons; house numbers and buildings require separate explicit address relations. Synthetic fixtures or shared UI code alone never establish M2.

agid_integration.current_scope: TL address-format metadata corrected to the August 2026 UPU syntax; no real Postal Context pack, runtime or searchable map area.
agid_integration.enablement_gate: Rights-cleared assignment and delivery-area artifact plus real loader/API/app verification is required.
agid_integration.geometry_rule: Only source-qualified Polygon/MultiPolygon postal features can drive the translucent search overlay; all other geometry stays typed and cannot be promoted.
